note: v0.127's note did not say that it moves your numbers. It does: a Loki design that had no nozzle exit diameter now has Loki's own published one, and since v0.119 that area buys thrust as the air thins. Measured on tester files, each flown twice with nothing else changed: +5.54 % on a 76 mm M900-LR, +0.87 % on a 38 mm J1026CT, +0.52 % on an I405-LW. If you fly Loki, re-open your designs and look at the nozzle exit diameter under the stage. Two exact ways back to the old numbers: clear the field, or pick Classic Extended Barrowman. And if you had a 76 mm exit machined out to 2.0 inches, type it - the app fills Loki's standard 1.818.
